i know it’s been said. but the loss of good mobile games for phones in the modern day is truly saddening.

playstation ditching physical games is "a bridge across the bad years" of high hardware costs, analyst says, but it means "casuals and youngsters will drift off to mobile, pc, and free-to-play even faster" - "killing physical media boards up one of the cheapest doorways into playstation".
